Tafsir MCP — Quranic Database
	



قاعدة بيانات القرآن الكريم والتفاسير لمشروع tafsir-mcp
برعاية مركز تفسير للدراسات القرآنية




	
		
	
	
		📖 Overview
	

This dataset is the data backbone for tafsir-mcp,
a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server providing scholarly, offline-first access to the Holy Quran
for AI assistants like Claude Code, Cursor, and any MCP-compatible client.
All content is sourced from and reviewed by Tafsir Center for Quranic Studies
(tafsir.net).


	
		
	
	
		📊… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/tafsircenter/tafsir-mcp-data.
